feed_summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, and logistics sectors across Europe and the U.S. have emerged as the target of a large-scale, industrialized campaign dubbed Trigram. "Trigram is a large-scale campaign that impersonates about 50 brands in the blockchain and AI sectors, to trick developers into executing an infostealer themselves," Stormshield said in a deep-dive technical report
title: Trigram Campaign Impersonates About 50 AI and Blockchain Brands to Target Devs with Infostealers
